This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

3. The present Writ Petition has been filed with the following prayer:-
"a) admit the writ petition:
b) call for the records:
c) issue Rule Nisi calling upon the opposite parties as to why for illegal acquisition/occupation of land of the Petitioners by Opp. Parties for widening of 'Balinga Taparia Road Project' in respect of an area of Khata No.24 of Mouza-Sambarpinda, Tahasil-Hemgir, Dist- Sundargarh shall not be acquired under the provision of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 by passing fresh award and the compensation shall not be paid to the petitioners within a time stipulated by this Hon'ble Court.
d) If the opp. Parties fail to show cause or shown insufficient cause the said rule Nisi be made absolute."

5. In course of hearing, learned counsel for the Petitioners states that highlighting their grievance,

sentences.text:
As agreed by learned counsel for the parties and after going through the records, this Court,
without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, disposes of the Writ Petition directing Opposite Party No.2 to consider the representation filed by the petitioners vide Annexure-4, and pass appropriate order in accordance with law within a period of three months from the date of production of certified copy of this order.
Issue urgent certified copy as per Rules.
